notes.title: DEVBLOG #5 - Vehicles through servers (Multiplayer fixes)
notes.content:
Some of you have probably experienced issues with multiplayer after the latest update. We are aware of them and we devoted our time towards solving some of the most common ones.

Vehicles through server
In the past every time a vehicle was spawned, data had to be sent directly to the other players. This data transfer didn't always go as planned and in some cases people couldn't get in their vehicles, the server had to be re-hosted and so on.

Recently we decided to make additional changes and send the vehicles through our server first. Instead of direct data transfers between players, the vehicles are uploaded to our servers and then passed on.

This approach is more reliable than direct transfer because it'll fix some of the most common issues. On the other hand once a vehicle has been spawned re-uploading it won't be necessary and therefore less data has to be sent.

Connecting
The update won't change anything about the way that you have to connect. Hosting a server still will require port forwarding in some cases whilst joining one won't.

Additional multiplayer update next week
One of the things you'll notice is the fact that your vehicles will disappear every time someone joins a server meaning that you'll have to respawn. We made it this way for now to ensure that nobody receives outdated data and it's something that we hope to eliminate in the next couple of days so that an additional update can be released somewhere next week.

In the past every time a vehicle was spawned, data had to be sent directly to the other players. This data transfer didn't always go as planned and in some cases people couldn't get in their vehicles, the server had to be re-hosted and so on.

Recently we decided to make additional changes and send the vehicles through our server first. Instead of direct data transfers between players, the vehicles are uploaded to our servers and then passed on.

This approach is more reliable than direct transfer because it'll fix some of the most common issues. On the other hand once a vehicle has been spawned re-uploading it won't be necessary and therefore less data has to be sent.

Connecting
The update won't change anything about the way that you have to connect. Hosting a server still will require port forwarding in some cases whilst joining one won't.

Additional multiplayer update next week
One of the things you'll notice is the fact that your vehicles will disappear every time someone joins a server meaning that you'll have to respawn. We made it this way for now to ensure that nobody receives outdated data and it's something that we hope to eliminate in the next couple of days so that an additional update can be released somewhere next week.

notes.title: DEVBLOG #2 - Mirage G8 parts
notes.content:
Soon it will be spring and we agree with the comments that the snow has been in-game for too long.Therefore the upcoming update will be snow free again! 

Mirage G8?

The Mirage G was a two-seat twin engine prototype that was developed in the sixties in France by the Dassault Aviation company to work as a multi-role jet fighter that could be used for both interception and nuclear strike missions.

For more information, make sure to visit Dassault's website. 

http://i.imgur.com/fo1YiSs.jpg

The full set contains the following parts:
Mirage G8 swept wing
Mirage G8 tail wing
Mirage G8 vertical tail wing
Mirage nose

Why these parts?

The Mirage G8 is a classic and we just couldn't resist it. The most interesting part is the fact that the set includes swept wings. After having tested them for a while we can't wait to see some of the crazy things that will be created with them.

The swept wing basically has two states that it can be in; for example -15° and 45°. Once you've set the states you can change the input and the time it takes to switch between both states. 

STATE I - REAR
http://i.imgur.com/WqCYi2m.jpg

STATE II - FRONT
http://i.imgur.com/BaQtzua.jpg

Mass label

We went through some of our earlier creations and thought that it'd be fun if there was a way to see their mass. That's why we've added a mass label that you can find next to the center of gravity on all your vehicles while you're in the tuning area.

http://i.imgur.com/zP6cpx5.jpg

Summary

While the Mirage G8 parts aren't the only ones that will be released in the new update, we really think that they have a lot of potential and that they'll make a fine addition to our collection (oh and make sure to check out this amazing podracer that Vq.I Count Squashula designed).

More information about new parts + changes will be available tomorrow.

notes.title: DEVBLOG #1
notes.content:
We're happy to see that you guys want to be more involved in the development process and that you'd like to know more about what direction we're heading in. Homebrew started out a while ago as a project for us and our friends and back then none of us could imagine that it would be the first game that we'd officially release, let alone that it would be on Early Access and that we'd have this community on such short notice. 

Thanks for all the feedback and suggestions you've given us so far and most of all for ensuring that we can continue development.

Like promised, we're working on making it a habit to share more information on the things that we're working on. This doesn't mean that we won't be active on the forums and chat anymore, so if you have suggestions or encounter issues you can contact us at any moment!

What are we working on?

The main reason why Homebrew is called a pre-alpha is because there's a lot of stuff that we want to add and there are some outdated systems that need to be replaced by cleaner and better ones. 

A while ago we succesfully migrated from Unity 4 to Unity 5 and started cleaning up our code. It's still a work in progress but we don't want to rely on things that will slow us down in the long run and cause some of the bigger bugs (like vehicle corruption for example). 

Cleaner and more optimized systems is a start, but we're working on the visual aspects as well. We gave Unity 5 a hard time by pushing its limits each day and have a better understanding of the opportunities and possible pitfalls that it holds for us.

You'll be able to read more on this topic in the following posts days/weeks.

Update

Right now we're prepping up the snow removal update. This took us a bit longer than expected due to additional changes but it'll be out in a matter of days. You'll be able to read more about them tomorrow.

notes.title: UPDATE January 11 2015 - Optimization!
notes.content:
Big Update!
We've got a pretty big optimization update!
We completely optimized the menu, trimmed down on the trees, and did some general optimization. 
Homebrew should run a bit smoother now (especially on older rigs), and we added an option to disable water reflection (Smooths out the game a ton!). 
We've also added a couple new race tracks, and a quest marker can randomly appear on top of a random race-track. 
We also added a boat race under the outer marks of the world. 

We've also made some changes in the Hangar, there's now a "More Tutorials" button on the bottom right, this'll disappear after a certain period. Clicking this will open up your browser with community video tutorials!
The pipe builder also has numbers on the grid now, as requested by some users. 


You can also paste your steam key directly into Homebrew now! (this took a bit longer then expected. Sorry guys.) 


Currently we're migrating to our new workstations, so we can work full-time on the UI update. 


TL;DR

Added
Added numbers on pipe building workbench
New Race tracks (Water land And Air! )
Option to disable Reflections
Paste Steam key
Map changes

Fixed
Optimized Menu
Optimized Trees
Optimized Map


Ps: we did more, but unfortunately we lost our bug-list. So we might update this list if we remember some other changes we made!


Update!: We just found another bug with Multiplayer, fix should be live now!

notes.title: Winter special update
notes.content:
Since it'll be Christmas and new year soon, we thought that this would be a great moment for an update and some gifts from us. Now let's have a look at what winter brings us this year:

Full sandbox mode
Like most of you probably know, the orbs were a temporary solution that  gave us some extra time to fix bugs and see how the game evolved. 

There has always been a way to get 'infinite" orbs (all praise Tesla for that), but we think that now the time is right to turn Homebrew into a full sandbox. 

Here's the stuff we changed to achieve this goal: 

Removed orbs
Removed warehouse
Reworked world tutorial
Changed save game structure
...

World
We were working on the optimization of the level and we started thinking about how we can give the world a more seasonal feel. Some of the changes that are listed below will remain for a long time while others (like snow for example) will be removed later on.

These are the biggest changes to the world:

Changed summer theme to winter
Added more roads and fixed/replaced old ones
Added snow + ice
Updated valley mountains
Made changes inside the dome
Added anti-lag level (type 123 no lag for me in chat to enable/disable it)
...

http://i.imgur.com/iRjNLHY.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/Aj4B9iG.jpg

Race tracks are here!
We've added multiple race tracks that are scattered around the world. This is just a small fraction of what we have in mind for the challenge editor in the future.

http://i.imgur.com/POdN3Gz.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/zzUokZL.jpg

New parts
We received a lot of awesome ideas from the community and this quickly resulted in a long wishlist :). We'll be releasing a lot more parts in the future and some of the suggestions will definitely be included.

Here are the parts for this update:

Fireworks
Burst rockets
VTOL tilt rotor


http://i.imgur.com/XuXW5dO.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/WqgaFLR.jpg

Bug and other fixes
We're still amazed about how much feedback we've received from our community. You guys helped us find and solve bugs faster and although we're still working on some of them, Homebrew gets a bit better every day. 

Here are the fixes in this update:

Fixed browning bug
Fixed rename bug
Fixed lights on water bug
Fixed electric motor bug: reverse gear should work fine now
Fixed some minor bugs
Fixed some text
...


Meet Joe
There was one important character missing so far, it was the mechanic named Joe and he is the other owner of the JOEDAN workshop. Just like Danny he has his own story to tell and you'll discover more about them further into development. 

For now however, Joe just wants to hang out and make some friends. 

http://i.imgur.com/GSDx31G.png
http://i.imgur.com/hu4o89o.png

Other changes

Added sounds
Added music
Added new third person camera mode
Reworked tutorial texts
Added invert_input property to propellers and other
You can now set tree distance to 0
Made changes to the pyramid ;)
Added force direction indicators
Added invert property to all axis-controllable
Cube scans vehicles in workshop
Added new default vehicles
Added new secret
Optimization
...

Like most of you probably know, the orbs were a temporary solution that  gave us some extra time to fix bugs and see how the game evolved. 

There has always been a way to get 'infinite" orbs (all praise Tesla for that), but we think that now the time is right to turn Homebrew into a full sandbox. 

Here's the stuff we changed to achieve this goal: 

Removed orbs
Removed warehouse
Reworked world tutorial
Changed save game structure
...

World
We were working on the optimization of the level and we started thinking about how we can give the world a more seasonal feel. Some of the changes that are listed below will remain for a long time while others (like snow for example) will be removed later on.

These are the biggest changes to the world:

Changed summer theme to winter
Added more roads and fixed/replaced old ones
Added snow + ice
Updated valley mountains
Made changes inside the dome
Added anti-lag level (type 123 no lag for me in chat to enable/disable it)
...

http://i.imgur.com/iRjNLHY.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/Aj4B9iG.jpg

Race tracks are here!
We've added multiple race tracks that are scattered around the world. This is just a small fraction of what we have in mind for the challenge editor in the future.

http://i.imgur.com/POdN3Gz.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/zzUokZL.jpg

New parts
We received a lot of awesome ideas from the community and this quickly resulted in a long wishlist :). We'll be releasing a lot more parts in the future and some of the suggestions will definitely be included.

Here are the parts for this update:

Fireworks
Burst rockets
VTOL tilt rotor


http://i.imgur.com/XuXW5dO.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/WqgaFLR.jpg

Bug and other fixes
We're still amazed about how much feedback we've received from our community. You guys helped us find and solve bugs faster and although we're still working on some of them, Homebrew gets a bit better every day. 

Here are the fixes in this update:

Fixed browning bug
Fixed rename bug
Fixed lights on water bug
Fixed electric motor bug: reverse gear should work fine now
Fixed some minor bugs
Fixed some text
...


Meet Joe
There was one important character missing so far, it was the mechanic named Joe and he is the other owner of the JOEDAN workshop. Just like Danny he has his own story to tell and you'll discover more about them further into development. 

For now however, Joe just wants to hang out and make some friends. 

http://i.imgur.com/GSDx31G.png
http://i.imgur.com/hu4o89o.png

Other changes

Added sounds
Added music
Added new third person camera mode
Reworked tutorial texts
Added invert_input property to propellers and other
You can now set tree distance to 0
Made changes to the pyramid ;)
Added force direction indicators
Added invert property to all axis-controllable
Cube scans vehicles in workshop
Added new default vehicles
Added new secret
Optimization
...

notes.title: Winners of the boat challenge
notes.content:
Now that the polls are closed, we are glad to announce the winners of the boat challenge. 

As mentioned before the top 5 would be selected by the community and we'd pick the top 3 afterwards based on the following criteria:

- possibility to be used as a standard vehicle
- handling & functionality
- name & design

[olist]
The Dude - The Dispatcher
In our opinion this is the boat that we were looking for! It'll need some testing before we include it as a default vehicle, but it looks like really stable and easy to tweak for beginners, ...
 
Sicbm.com - War Boat 01
Amazing boat which shows a lot of what you can build in Homebrew if you put some effort into it. We'd love to have the vehicle for ourselves, but we think that it is just too advanced to be included as a default vehicle.

pen4711 - Water Skipper and Xacto - Oceanis
This was one was just too difficult to choose because both boats have a lot of potential and are too different at the same time. Therefore you guys share a well deserved third place.
[/olist]

I've added all of you so that we can send you guys the keys.

We'll be doing future challenges soon, so keep an eye out on our community hub.


Cheers!

Copybugpaste Team

notes.title: Making progress on the new user interface
notes.content:
Our team is currently working hard on the new UI.

We'll be talking more about the updates in future announcements, but here are a few features that we want to include:


New menu
Full controller support
Easier control setup
Better navigation in the workshop
Improved tutorial system
Less resource intensive for your PC
Updates can occur directly from our server
...

We noticed that the update will allow us to optimize multiplayer a lot and take the first steps towards a plating/armor system.

If you have any suggestions, feel free to post on the community hub. We'll definitely look into them.

Cheers!

Copybugpaste Team

notes.title: [GLITCH] Hovercraft Cushions Blowers
notes.content:
Aware
HOVERCRAFT CUSHIONS have a small chance to corrupt your vehicles.
We have yet found a fix, but are working on it! 

Adding a new part after your hovercraft cushion blower has been LINKED to nodes, your vehicle has a small chance to get corrupted.
We have not been able to recreate this glitch with every try, so we're not sure what's the cause of it. But we're working on it.
